heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 102–367, title IV, § 403(a)(4), Sept. 7, 1992, 106 Stat. 1084

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 97–300, title IV, § 456, as added Pub. L. 99–496, § 14(a), Oct. 16, 1986, 100 Stat. 1265, related to projects designed to serve populations with multiple barriers to employment.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective July 1, 1993, see section 701(a) of Pub. L. 102–367, formerly set out as an Effective Date of 1992 Amendment; Transition Provisions note under section 1501 of this title.
